ns2:course.label: Life Contingencies I
ns2:course.description: Distribution of the time-to-death random variable for a single life, and its implications for evaluations of insurance and annuity functions, net premiums, and reserves. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ASRM 401 (formerly MATH 408) and ASRM 210 (formerly MATH 210).
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ASRM 401 (formerly MATH 408) and ASRM 210 (formerly MATH 210).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
